steps.caption: A browser tab loads the plan page and holds one WebSocket to the web Worker.
The web Worker renders routes and reaches data only over the service binding.
Hono is the edge of the api Worker and owns routing, status codes and JSON.
Behind Hono, Commands, Flags and PlanRooms are Effect services in one ManagedRuntime.
packages/domain decides, evolves and projects, and the upcaster still waits unwired.
packages/schema is the glossary as Effect Schema, imported by web, api and domain.
apps/checkin is a standalone Worker that shares the toolchain and imports nothing.
